App management policy: rules for federated identity credentials
f: A new restriction in the tenant's app management policy (applicationRestrictions). The name says the policy can now govern federated identity credentials (workload identity federation, for example GitHub Actions or Kubernetes) on app registrations. Nothing published yet.

records.t: App management policy: trusted certificate subjects and issuers
f: A new restriction in the app management policy. The name says certificates on app registrations could be limited to trusted subject names and issuers - a step beyond the 'trusted certificate authorities' restriction Microsoft introduced in 2023. Nothing published for this property.

records.t: App management policy: credentials on service principals
f: A new restriction for service principals (enterprise applications) in the app management policy. Nothing published yet.

records.t: Opt-out settings of the authentication methods policy
f: A settings block on the authentication methods policy, empty (null) in our tenant. The name says admins can opt users or the tenant out of something the policy turns on. Nothing published yet.

records.t: New authentication method: federated identity credential - who it applies to
f: The whole method configuration 'federatedIdentityCredential' is new: it is not in $metadata at all. includeTargets is the usual 'which users and groups' list every method has. Nothing published yet.

records.t: New authentication method: federated identity credential - profiles
f: Profiles of the new, unpublished 'federatedIdentityCredential' authentication method; the name suggests several configurations of the method (for example per external identity provider). Nothing published yet.

records.t: Password change after a secure sign-in
f: Lets users change their password in My Sign-Ins after signing in with a strong credential (passkey, FIDO2 security key, Windows Hello for Business), without typing the current password and without SSPR. Off by default; Microsoft rolls it out worldwide in October and November 2026 (MC1437671). Jan B…

records.t: Custom greeting in voice-call MFA
f: Whether voice-call MFA plays the tenant's own greeting. Microsoft retired custom greetings in voice call authentication on 28/02/2026 (MC1219798): calls now play Microsoft's default recording. Most likely the switch of the retired feature, still returned by the service.

records.t: Conditional Access target: agent actions
f: A new target in Conditional Access: actions an AI agent performs, next to apps and user actions. Microsoft documents Conditional Access for agents on Learn; this property is not named there yet.

records.t: Conditional Access condition: agent session risk
f: A risk level of an agent's session. The beta Learn page documents agentIdRiskLevels (risk of the agent identity); this one, for the session, is not documented yet.

records.t: Conditional Access condition: clients
f: A new condition named 'clients', found inside the details block of a Conditional Access object. Nothing published yet.

records.t: Conditional Access condition: federated tokens
f: A new condition. The name says a policy could apply to sign-ins that use tokens from a federated identity provider. Nothing published yet.

records.t: Conditional Access condition: Purview DLP rules
f: A new condition linking Conditional Access with Microsoft Purview data loss prevention rules. Microsoft's roadmap item RM571397 describes Purview inline DLP for Entra-managed apps in Edge for Business that integrates with a Conditional Access grant control; this property is not named there.

records.t: Conditional Access condition: time
f: A condition on time - the name says a policy could apply only on certain days or hours. Nothing published yet.

records.t: Conditional Access: partial enablement
f: A new property of a Conditional Access policy. The name says a policy could be switched on for part of its scope first - a staged rollout of the policy itself. Nothing published yet.

records.t: Conditional Access session control: block sensitive actions
f: A new session control. The name says a session could be allowed while sensitive actions in it stay blocked. Nothing published yet.

records.t: Conditional Access session control: human approval
f: A new session control. The name says a person would have to approve before the session (most likely an agent's) continues. Nothing published yet.

records.t: Conditional Access session control: network access security
f: A new session control. The name points to Global Secure Access - sending the session through its security profile. Nothing published yet.

records.t: Apply cross-tenant defaults to domain-based organizations
f: A switch on the cross-tenant access policy. The name says the default settings would also apply to external organizations identified by domain rather than by tenant ID. Nothing published yet.

records.t: Cross-cloud meetings in the default cross-tenant settings
f: A block in the default cross-tenant access settings. The name matches Teams cross-cloud meetings (meeting people in other Microsoft 365 clouds, for example GCC High or 21Vianet), which Microsoft describes on Learn; the property itself is not named there.

records.t: Protected content sharing in the default cross-tenant settings
f: A block in the default cross-tenant access settings. The name points to sharing protected (encrypted, labelled) content with other organizations. Nothing published yet.

records.t: Users can register agent identity blueprints
f: The switch behind 'Users can register agent identity blueprints' in Default user role permissions of the authorization policy. It is separate from 'Users can register applications', so blocking app registrations does not block blueprints. Three community articles describe it; Microsoft has not put …

records.t: Organization: on-premises sync status
f: A new property of the organization object. The name says it reports the state of directory synchronization (Entra Connect or Cloud Sync) for the tenant. Nothing published yet.

records.t: Security defaults: which controls they enforce
f: A list on the security defaults policy. The name says which controls security defaults enforce (for example MFA registration, blocking legacy authentication). Nothing published yet.

records.t: Security defaults: upsell
f: A block on the security defaults policy. The name says it holds the prompt that moves a tenant from security defaults to Conditional Access. Nothing published yet.

records.t: Trust a compliant network from another tenant
f: our tenant returns it · on Learn, not in $metadata

Whether your Conditional Access accepts the 'compliant network' claim (Global Secure Access) of users from another Entra organization, like it can accept their MFA or compliant device. Microsoft describes it on the beta Learn page of crossTenantAccessPolicyInboundTrust; the $metadata lacks it.

records.t: CRL validation of certificate-based authentication
f: our tenant returns it · in v1.0, missing from beta $metadata

How Entra checks certificate revocation lists (CRL) for certificate-based authentication. Microsoft documents it in Graph v1.0 (x509CertificateCrlValidationConfiguration); only the beta $metadata lacks it.

records.t: Conditional Access policy created from a template
f: our tenant returns it · in v1.0, missing from beta $metadata
The template a Conditional Access policy was created from. Documented in Graph v1.0; only the beta $metadata lacks it.
